title: Not what I expected
body: Too many unnecessary questions in the flow. The AI voice is terrible, it’s not pleasant to listen to. The AI image on the purchase page is annoying. And the pricing is a major barrier it’s hard to justify the cost when the core features don’t feel premium. At this point, users would be better off just using their phone’s built-in planner. They don’t give you a choice but rating the app 5 stars after the last question, weird . Also no chance to chance option after we answered a question by mistake, fixe it at least.
author: Zii_el

title: Not worth it
body: It makes you all of these questions just to make you pay a life time of all of its features for 17,99. The, when you are about to close the app because it is outrageous, it says “ Wait don’t go” and changes the offer to 5.99. Don’t waste your time.
